issues.observation: Narrow expanded previews are approximately 96–111 px square, close to thumbnail size. The whole image and both actions fit; the standard specifies a maximum height but no minimum, so this is an advisory observation, not a failed requirement.
issues.repair_suggestion: Consider a clearly discoverable larger preview for image-detail inspection while preserving action visibility; no blocking repair required for this batch.

issues.criteria_ref: visual-acceptance-criteria.md § timeline-three-rounds; harness supplementary top/bottom pairing
issues.observation: Top screenshots show all three ordered headers/thumbnails; bottom screenshots show the complete expanded third attempt and actions. Neither frame alone proves both portions. Visible scroll-boundary cuts are ordinary viewport scrolling, not overlapping panels.
issues.repair_suggestion: Keep both captures together in acceptance evidence; no UI repair required.

issues.criteria_ref: visual-acceptance-criteria.md § library-after-delete; global seed-word exception D-50a
issues.observation: Library screenshots show the retained image preview and entry; verify-after-delete screenshots show only the remaining session. These complementary views cover the cross-tab requirement. The narrow library row extends below the viewport and library seed metadata is allowed.
issues.repair_suggestion: Retain the paired image-page and library evidence. Optionally add a library capture with the selected row fully in view for easier review; no blocking UI repair required.

summary: Opened and visually inspected all 54 listed PNGs (27 states × 2 viewports). Passed: 0 blockers, 0 majors, 0 minors; 3 advisory notes. No visible broken/blank image frames, image-page seed labels, horizontal scrollbar, clipped action labels or panel occlusion. Declared gradient/mock layers accepted. This is screenshot visual acceptance, not verification of hidden DOM attributes or behavior.
